display_name: What a Singapore family gets under the SG Child Support Package — and which lines go down
scope: The five money lines of the SG Child Support Package (Baby Gift, Child Credits, CDA First Step Grant, CDA co-matching cap, PSEA top-up) across all six birth cohorts life.gov.sg publishes, together with the Baby Bonus Scheme and Large Families Scheme they replace and the transition arithmetic between them; and childcare leave under Child Development Co-Savings Act 2001 ss 12B, 12C and 12CA in the shape those sections are written, with the announced 8/10/12-day merger as a dated arm. 79 assertions, all passing. NOT COVERED, on the record: maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave (which makes the employer-cost finding a lower bound); the preschool fee reductions and BTO changes announced at the same Rally; Edusave; and Baby Bonus rates for a birth before 2015-01-01, where the comparison functions REFUSE rather than quote a rate nobody measured. Nine forks in registers/fork-register.json; two are materialised and execute both ways.
